no 18-item invariant enumeration exists in the tree. The real, enumerable protections are: 30 adversarial gate cases (G0a-G27, spine_sim), 8 structural-hardening controls (H1-H8, CHANGES-REGISTRY CR-123..CR-127), and the per-run mechanical checks in verify_pack.py + check_evidence.py. The README quotes those real counts instead.
